Import trades from IBKR

Auto-import asks Claude to pull your recent fills directly from your connected IBKR account and drop them straight in — no CSV needed. It only works while you're signed into Claude with IBKR connected, and each request is capped in size, so keep date ranges reasonably narrow (a week or two at a time works best).
Prefer manual? Export a Trades CSV from IBKR (Activity Statement or Flex Query) and paste it below instead.

No PIN set.
This only gates the app's screen — anyone with browser developer tools could still bypass it, so don't rely on it for real security. Forgetting the PIN never deletes your data; use "Forgot PIN?" on the lock screen to remove the lock.

Signed in as
Sign in with the same account on your phone and your laptop and they stay in step as you go — a trade logged on one is on the other in a few seconds.
Syncs: trades, daily notes, journals, the playbook, rules, your strategy and mistake lists, account size and deposits, goals, the watchlist, saved filters, and your daily plans with their checklist. Which trades you’ve been through in a day review syncs with each trade.
Stays on each device: screenshots, your style and colours, dashboards, charts and the backtester. A backup (Data) carries everything, screenshots included.
